hook.name: AnyPositionManager (Flaunch vested launch hook)
hook.description: Flaunch's hook for vested memecoin launches. Gates swaps on a per-pool scheduled open time (temporal fair-launch window), runs an internal swap pool that fills orders from fee inventory before Uniswap sees them, manages a bid wall, and distributes swap fees with optional referrer splits. Pools pair memecoins against registry-approved tokens.
